verdicts.statement: According to page 1, SAP lists two SAP HANA system types.
verdicts.reason: The context lists two SAP HANA system types: single-host systems and multi-node / distributed / scale-out clusters.

verdicts.statement: A single-host SAP HANA system consists of one SAP HANA instance on one host server.
verdicts.reason: The context explicitly defines a single-host system as one SAP HANA instance on one host server.

verdicts.statement: A multi-node, distributed, or scale-out SAP HANA cluster is a system installed across multiple host servers.
verdicts.reason: The context explicitly describes a multi-node / distributed / scale-out cluster as a system installation across multiple host servers.
